label: prop:exterior-square-borromean
title: 45 = dim_q Λ²(V_natural^10) — Borromean strand-pair representation
html:
The exterior square \Lambda^2 V_{\mathrm{nat}} of the natural permutation representation V_{\mathrm{nat}} = \mathbb{C}^{10} carries dimension 45. Under S_{10}, it decomposes as:

  \Lambda^2 V_{\mathrm{nat}} \;\cong\; V_{(9,1)} \oplus V_{(8,1,1)}.

The 9-dimensional standard representation and the 36-dimensional hook representation exhaust the 45-dimensional space.
heading: Proposition
